proposed.text: What air space is required for wood girder ends entering masonry or concrete walls unless approved resistant or treated wood is used?

options.text: 15 mm on tops, sides, and ends.

rationale.correct: Section 605.6 requires a 15 mm air space on tops, sides, and ends unless approved resistant or treated wood is used.
rationale.takeaway: Girder-end protection is checked by the 15 mm air-space rule.
